description: LangChain prompt templates used in the reranker_rag pipeline.

chunker.description: SemanticChunker does not use an LLM prompt. It computes cosine-similarity distances between sentence embeddings and splits at distances above the breakpoint threshold.

reranker.description: BGE Cross-Encoder reranker — no LLM prompt. Pairs (query, doc_text) are passed through the CrossEncoder to produce a bidirectional semantic relevance score. Results are sorted descending and sliced to top_n=3.

rag_qa_template.description: Main prompt for answering a question given the top-3 BGE-reranked context chunks (chat mode via ChatAnthropic).
rag_qa_template.notes:
context is formed by joining each reranked Document's page_content with '

---

'. question is the raw user query.
